problem: Users lose their last selected workout after the app is closed.
proposedChange: Resume the last saved workout on relaunch.
userFlow: Select a workout, save, quit, relaunch and resume.

signals.observation: Reporter had to select the same workout again.
Reproduced on iPhone following a cold start.

acceptance: After a cold start, the last saved workout is available to resume.
A workout closed without saving does not replace the saved workout.

impact.scope: Canada, all new iOS installs, exact resume-event query
